headlines.description: Joe Flacco threw three touchdown passes, and the Baltimore Ravens beat Cleveland 28-7 on Thursday night to leave the winless Browns at a historic low point in franchise history.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flacco, Ravens keep Browns winless with 28-7 rout

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: Marcus Mariota threw for 295 yards and four touchdowns and the Tennessee Titans routed the Green Bay Packers 47-25 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans score 21 points in 1st quarter, rout Packers 47-25

events.name: Denver Broncos at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Denver's Justin Simmons used a perfectly timed leap to block an extra point that would have given New Orleans a late lead, and Will Parks ran it back 84 yards for two points and a Broncos win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blocked point-after kick lifts Broncos past Saints, 25-23

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at New York Jets

headlines.description: Alec Ogletree intercepted Bryce Petty with just under 2 minutes left, lifting the Los Angeles Rams to a 9-6 victory over the New York Jets in a snoozer Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams spoil Petty's first NFL start in 9-6 win over Jets

headlines.description: Ryan Mathews ran for 108 yards and two touchdowns, a tenacious defense held down the league's highest-scoring offense and the Philadelphia Eagles beat the Atlanta Falcons 24-15 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan Mathews runs for 2 scores, Eagles beat Falcons 24-15

events.name: Chicago Bears at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Jameis Winston threw for 312 yards and two touchdowns to lead the Tampa Bay Buccaneers to a 36-10 victory over the mistake-prone Chicago Bears on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston throws for 312 yards, Buccaneers rout Bears 36-10

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw for two touchdowns, Preston Smith had two sacks and a game-altering interception, and the Washington Redskins beat the Minnesota Vikings 26-20 on Sunday for their first victory
headlines.shortLinkText: Preston Smith, Redskins hand Vikings fourth consecutive loss

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Marcus Peters stripped Kelvin Benjamin with 20 seconds left, Cairo Santos kicked a 37-yard field goal as time expired, and the Chiefs overcame a 17-point deficit to top the Panthers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Late turnover lifts Chiefs to 20-17 win over Panthers

headlines.description: Brock Osweiler threw two touchdown passes, Kareem Jackson returned an interception 42 yards for a score and the Houston Texans handed the Jacksonville Jaguars another home loss, 24-21 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans beat Jaguars 24-21 for 1st road victory of season

events.name: Miami Dolphins at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Kiko Alonso intercepted Philip Rivers' pass and returned it 60 yards for a touchdown with 1:01 left to give Miami a wild 31-24 victory over the San Diego Chargers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alonso's pick-6 of Rivers lifts Dolphins to wild 31-24 win

headlines.description: Chandler Catanzaro kicked a 34-yard field goal as time expired and the Arizona Cardinals escaped with a 23-20 victory over the San Francisco 49ers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arizona escapes with win on Catanzaro's field goal

headlines.description: Ezekiel Elliott and the Dallas Cowboys just keep on rolling. Not even a fake-spike special from Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Ben Roethlisberger could derail the hottest team in the NFL.
headlines.shortLinkText: Elliott scores twice late, Cowboys top Steelers 35-30

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at New England Patriots

headlines.description: This time, Seattle won it at the goal line.
headlines.shortLinkText: Goal line defense works out for Seahawks this time

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at New York Giants

headlines.description: Eli Manning threw his third touchdown pass of the game on a fourth-down gamble by coach rookie Ben McAdoo, and the New York Giants beat the Cincinnati Bengals 21-20 Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning throws 3 TDs as gambling Giants beat Bengals
